dedupe_keys.name: danmarks statistik port and maritime datasets

description: Danmarks Statistik: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Danmarks Statistik. Coverage: Danmarks Statistik. The listing groups 18 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Indenrigs færgetransport efter færgerute og enhed; Udenrigs færgetransport efter færgerute og enhed; Omsætning af container- og ro-ro-enheder på større danske havne efter ; Skibsanløb på danske havne efter havn, skibstype og bruttotonnage (BT). Formats seen: XLSX, JSON, CSV, HTML, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
